video.topic: Cursor can now read and write directly to your Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) from its connectors page

transcript.text: If you're using Cursor, you can now connect directly to your Google Workspace. This gives you read and write access to Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, as well as Google Sheets. Now, you can do this by connecting your cursor from the customized page directly to your Google Workspace. Now follow for more AI news, videos, and tutorials each and every single day, and catch you in the next one
